extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers, early-career investigators, mid-career clinical investigators, and mentors seeking NIMHD K-series career development awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers to identify appropriate NIMHD Research Career Development (K series) awards based on career stage, research focus (including patient-oriented research), and whether an independent clinical trial is proposed. Helps applicants choose the correct parent PA and understand award purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: K01 – Mentored Research Scientist Career Development Award
rubrics_metrics.description: K01 awards support postdoctoral or early career research scientists committed to research who need advanced research training and additional experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two parent announcements: PA-24-175 – Mentored Research Scientist Development Award (Parent K01 Independent Clinical Trial Required) and PA-24-176 – Mentored Research Scientist Development Award (Parent K01 Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed). Use the appropriate PA depending on whether the proposed work includes an independent clinical trial.

rubrics_metrics.name: K08 – Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award
rubrics_metrics.description: K08 awards support promising clinical scientists with demonstrated aptitude to develop into independent investigators, or faculty members to pursue research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two parent announcements: PA-24-181 – Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award (Parent K08 Independent Clinical Trial Required) and PA-24-182 – Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award (Parent K08 Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed). Choose the PA matching your clinical trial status.

rubrics_metrics.name: K23 – Mentored Patient-Oriented Research Career Development Award
rubrics_metrics.description: K23 awards support the career development of clinically trained professionals who have made a commitment to patient-oriented research, and who have the potential to develop into productive clinical investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two parent announcements: PA-24-184 – Mentored Patient-Oriented Research Career Development Award (Parent K23 Independent Clinical Trial Required) and PA-24-185 – Mentored Patient-Oriented Research Career Development Award (Parent K23 Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed). Applicable for clinician-investigators focused on patient-oriented research; select announcement per clinical trial involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: K24 – Midcareer Investigator Award in Patient-Oriented Research
rubrics_metrics.description: K24 awards support protected time for mid-career health-professional doctorates to devote to patient-oriented research and to act as research mentors for junior clinical investigators pursuing patient-oriented research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two parent announcements: PA-24-187 – Midcareer Investigator Award in Patient-Oriented Research (Parent K24 Independent Clinical Trial Required) and PA-24-188 – Midcareer Investigator Award in Patient-Oriented Research (Parent K24 Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed). Intended to provide protected time and formal mentoring responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: K99/R00 – Pathway to Independence Award
rubrics_metrics.description: K99/R00 awards support an initial mentored research experience (K99) followed by independent research (R00) for highly qualified, postdoctoral researchers, to secure an independent research position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two parent announcements: PA-24-193 – NIH Pathway to Independence Award (Parent K99/R00 Independent Clinical Trial Required) and PA-24-194 – NIH Pathway to Independence Award (Parent K99/R00 Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed). Recipients of these awards are expected to compete successfully for independent R01 support during the R00 phase. See NOT-OD-25-121 for Temporary Extension of Eligibility for the NIH Pathway to Independence Award (K99/R00).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent clinical trial designation in parent PAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Each K-series parent funding announcement is issued in two variants specifying whether an independent clinical trial is required or not allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must select the correct parent PA (Independent Clinical Trial Required vs Independent Clinical Trial Not Allowed) that matches the proposed research plan. The PA numbers for each variant are listed alongside each award type on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted career stages and goals for NIMHD K awards
rubrics_metrics.description: NIMHD K-series awards are targeted to specific career stages (postdoctoral/early career, clinical investigators, mid-career mentors) and specific research emphases (patient-oriented research, mentorship, transition to independence).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the award descriptions to match applicant career stage and goals: K01 for advanced training of research scientists; K08 for clinical scientists developing into independent investigators; K23 for clinically trained professionals committed to patient-oriented research; K24 for mid-career clinician-mentors; K99/R00 for postdocs transitioning to independence.
